\cvsection{SUMMARY}

Computer science engineering student at ENSEEIHT with hands-on experience in NLP and LLM fine-tuning. Following an internship at CPMS, I have been developing document-classification and language-model adaptation solutions as a freelancer since October 2026.

\cvsection{SKILLS}

\textbf{AI / NLP:} Transformers, BERT-family models, document classification, supervised LLM fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, model evaluation.\\[1.6pt]
\textbf{Libraries:} PyTorch, Hugging Face (Transformers, Datasets, PEFT, TRL), Unsloth, bitsandbytes.\\[1.6pt]
\textbf{Programming / tools:} Python, C, OCaml, Ada, SQL, Linux; data preparation, tokenization, GPU optimization.

\cvsection{PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE}

\cvrole{Freelance AI \& Machine Learning | \href{\CPMSURL}{CPMS}}{Oct 2026 - Present}{Medical plan TPA | Toulouse, France | Remote}

\begin{cvbullets}

  \item Developing a document-classification workflow: text extraction/OCR, data preparation and BERT-family NLP models.

  \item Fine-tuning language models for domain-specific needs; evaluating performance and analyzing errors.

  \item Integrating models into applications through a FastAPI interface.

\end{cvbullets}

\vspace{4pt}

\cvrole{AI / LLM Fine-tuning Intern | \href{\CPMSURL}{CPMS}}{Jun 2026 - Jul 2026}{Medical plan TPA | Paris, France | On-site}

\begin{cvbullets}

  \item Studied Transformer architectures and adapted open-source LLMs to a business use case involving medical content and privacy constraints.

  \item Built instruction-response datasets: cleaning, normalization, tokenization and chat-template formatting.

  \item Ran supervised fine-tuning experiments with LoRA / QLoRA, hyperparameter tuning and 4-/8-bit quantization to manage GPU memory use.

  \item Compared prompting and fine-tuning through error analysis, examining overfitting, hallucinations and generalization.

\end{cvbullets}
